description: SU(4) BMN index, eigenvalue graviton index and difference through j=30, SU(3)_R rep content
conventions: BMN sector of SU(N); sector = (2J, q1, q2, q3) with q_I = R_I + J, j = 2 sum q; Chang-Lin / Choi et al. conventions (summary/fortuity-summary.pdf, section 2)
checked: Z - Zgrav = -chi[2,0] t^28 + chi[1,1] t^30 reproduces eq. (3.15) of arXiv:2312.16443 (core -[2,0] at 28, -[3,0] at 30) with descendant weight t^2 x_I
caveat: diagonal graviton count; the j=28 term may be an artifact (see R-002, R-003)
